incident_description:
Between 18:31 and 19:33  UTC February 11, 2026, customers in Canada Central may have experienced degraded performance when creating, accessing, or running declarative pipelines.

The incident is now closed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Impact Summary
Between 11 February 2026 00:52 UTC and 11 February 2026 12:45 UTC, login attempts using Microsoft Social Login (SSO) may have failed.

Symptoms
Customers may have encountered 401 authentication errors when signing in via Microsoft Social Login (SSO).

Current Status
This incident is resolved. Microsoft Social Login (SSO) authentication is functioning normally.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Next Update
No further updates are planned unless conditions change.
